en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a railway station building beside several sets of train tracks. The station is a wooden structure with decorative timber framing, a steep roof, and a central gable. Several people stand on the platform in front of the building. Large trees line the area beside the station. Printed text at the top right identifies the scene as the railway station in Emmaboda, and signage on the building also reads "EMMABODA" along with some smaller, less legible text.
